purpose: Bind external CSV schemas to the already-frozen C030 endpoint without changing its hypothesis, offsets, effect threshold, sign-test threshold, replication tolerance, or interpretation.

exposure_boundary.before_parent_freeze: No target raw CSV values inspected.
exposure_boundary.after_parent_freeze_before_this_binding: CSV header requests exposed the header plus two exemplar rows for each dataset; no aggregate statistics, matched-pair residuals, FIRST_BREAK values, or threshold tuning were performed.
exposure_boundary.consequence: This binding may resolve column names and deterministic duplicate/zero handling only; it may not alter any scientific threshold.

deterministic_binding_rules.time_match: Exact numeric equality to integer offsets -d and +d within floating representation tolerance 1e-9; no nearest-neighbor matching and no interpolation in C030.
deterministic_binding_rules.duplicate_subject_day: If multiple finite Ct observations exist for the exact same subject and exact same offset, use their median before mirror pairing.
deterministic_binding_rules.finite_values: Parse numeric finite Ct values only; blank/NA/non-finite values are missing.
deterministic_binding_rules.sign_test_zero_residual: Zero residuals contribute to n_matched and to the median effect but are omitted from the Bernoulli sign count; if all residuals are zero, sign-test p=1.
deterministic_binding_rules.sign_test: Two-sided exact Binomial(n_nonzero,0.5), p=2*min(P[X<=k],P[X>=k]) capped at 1.
deterministic_binding_rules.primary_scope: Use all subjects present in the frozen file; no post-hoc subgroup filtering.
deterministic_binding_rules.replication_scope: Use all subjects present in the frozen file; B117Status is not used for subgroup tuning in C030.

unchanged_from_parent.direction_prediction: median Ct(+d)-Ct(-d) < 0 at the first robust break
